russia.title: Flag of Russia
desc: - Three equal horizontal stripes of white, blue, and red, adopted on 22 August 1991
- The tricolour traces back to Tsar Peter the Great's merchant flag of the 1690s
trivia:
- The white represents peace, the blue represents faith and loyalty, the red represents courage
- This tricolour was established by Peter the Great in the 17th century
- Russia's flag has been used continuously since 1991 after the fall of the Soviet Union
